# Psalm 84 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** To-the-choirmaster. On the-Gittith. Of-the-sons-of Korah. A-psalm.

**2** How lovely your-dwelling-places, O-YHWH of-hosts!

**3** Longs and-also pines my-soul for-courts-of YHWH; my-heart and-my-flesh cry-out to God living.

**4** Also a-bird has-found a-home, and-a-swallow a-nest for-herself where she-has-placed her-young — your-altars, O-YHWH of-hosts, my-King and-my-God.

**5** Blessed are-those dwelling in-your-house; still they-will-praise-you. Selah.

**6** Blessed the-man whose-strength is-in-you, highways in-their-heart.

**7** Passing through valley-of Baca, a-spring they-make-it; also blessings wraps the-early-rain.

**8** They-go from-strength to-strength; he-appears before God in-Zion.

**9** O-YHWH God-of hosts hear my-prayer; give-ear O-God-of Jacob. Selah.

**10** Our-shield see O-God, and-look-upon the-face-of your-anointed.

**11** For better a-day in-your-courts than-a-thousand; I-choose to-stand-at-the-threshold in-house-of my-God than-to-dwell in-tents-of wickedness.

**12** For a-sun and-shield YHWH God; grace and-glory YHWH gives; not he-withholds good to-those-walking in-integrity.

**13** O-YHWH of-hosts, blessed the-man trusting in-you.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **84:4**: The sparrow and swallow nesting at the altars — a poignant image of finding home in God's presence; the psalmist envies even the birds.

- **84:7**: Valley-of-Baca (baka' — 'weeping/balsam trees') — the difficult journey to Zion is transformed into blessing by the pilgrim's faith.

- **84:12**: 'Sun and-shield' — YHWH as sun (shemesh) is unique in the Psalter; rare solar imagery for God in Israel.

— EMET
